    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AotCacheBuilder
    Trains a JDK AOT cache for a JAR in place, and verifies it.
    AotCacheGate
    The verification gate of a trained cache.
    AotCacheGate.Coverage
    What a strict launch took from the cache.
    AotCacheOutput
    Builds the self-contained directory of a cached deployment from a Runner JAR: the program, a verified JDK AOT cache trained in place, the launch argfile, the identity file, the report and the logs.
    AotCacheReport
    What the verification gate found, written as aot-report.json next to the cache.
    AotCacheSettings
    How a JDK AOT cache is built and how strictly it is verified.
    AotCacheSettings.Builder
    Collects cache settings, starting from the defaults.
    AotLaunchOptions
    The files that go with a trained cache: the launch argfile, which carries the options production launches with, and the identity file, which records what the cache is tied to.
    AotLayout
    Writes the extracted layout of a Runner JAR, the deployment a JDK AOT cache serves in full: an application JAR whose manifest Class-Path lists lib/*.jar in class-path order, and the dependencies under lib/, byte for byte the JARs the Runner JAR nests.
    AotLayout.Result
    An extracted layout.
    AotTarget
    What a JDK AOT cache is trained for: the extracted layout, which every JDK caches in full, or a copy of the single Runner JAR, whose nested classes JDK 27 and later do not cache.
    ApplicationManifest
    The part of an application's manifest the packaging library reads, for a build tool that describes that manifest in its own model rather than as a file.
    ArchiveSource
    Random access to the bytes of the outer runner archive.
    BuildLogger
    Where the packaging library reports what it did and what looked wrong.
    Compression
    How a dependency is stored inside the runner jar.
    CpuProbe
    Prints how many CPUs a JVM sees.
    Dependency
    One dependency to nest into the runner jar, together with the coordinates it was resolved from.
    Entry
    The application entry point, as seen by the launcher.
    Handler
    The jar: protocol handler of a runner application.
    Handlers
    The jar: URL machinery of a runner jar: it owns the registration of Handler, the state that handler serves, and the construction of every URL the class loader hands out.
    Index
    The reader of MICRONAUT-INF/index.bin, the table of contents a runner jar carries so that the launcher never parses a nested archive at startup.
    IndexFormat
    The on-disk layout of MICRONAUT-INF/index.bin, the index a runner jar carries so that the launcher never has to parse a nested archive's central directory at startup.
    JdkAotCacheMojo
    Trains a JDK AOT cache for the Runner JAR that mn-runner:package wrote, and verifies it, in target/micronaut-runner/jdk-aot-cache/: the extracted layout (or a copy of the Runner JAR), the cache, the launch argfile app.jvmopts, the identity file, the report and the logs.
    JdkAotCacheSpec
    The JDK AOT cache that micronautRunnerJdkAotCache trains and verifies: the jdkAotCache { } block of the MicronautRunnerExtension.
    JdkProbe
    What a JDK AOT cache is tied to, as one launch of a java executable reports it: the exact VM build, the operating system and the CPU architecture, and whether cache creation takes -XX:+AOTCompatibleOopCompression.
    Launcher
    The Main-Class of every runner jar.
    LayoutMojo
    Writes the extracted layout of the Runner JAR that mn-runner:package wrote, to target/micronaut-runner/layout/: the application JAR and lib/, for a build that trains its JDK AOT cache elsewhere, such as in a container image.
    MicronautRunnerExtension
    The packaging options of every archive the plugin builds, and its kill switch.
    MicronautRunnerJar
    Packages the application and its dependencies into a runner jar.
    MicronautRunnerJar.DependencyInput
    One position in the ordered dependency input sequence.
    MicronautRunnerJdkAotCache
    Trains a JDK AOT cache for the Runner JAR and verifies it: stages the program in its output directory (the extracted layout, or a copy of the Runner JAR), records a training run with the project's toolchain, creates the cache, and runs the verification gate.
    MicronautRunnerLayout
    Writes the extracted layout of the Runner JAR, the application JAR and lib/, for a build that trains its JDK AOT cache elsewhere, such as in a container image.
    MicronautRunnerPlugin
    Packages a Micronaut application as a runner jar: one executable archive in which every dependency remains an intact nested jar.
    PackageMojo
    Packages a Micronaut application as a runner jar: one executable archive in which every dependency remains an intact nested jar.
    PackagingComparison
    Times Runner and Shadow packaging of a copy of benchmark-large in one warm, dedicated Gradle daemon.
    PackagingProfile
    Profiles clean and edit-cycle packaging over deterministic input shapes.
    PackagingProfile.Worker
    Fresh-JVM worker so every attempt has independent allocation and peak-heap state.
    RecordStartupProfile
    Records the startup profile of the application: launches the runner jar, waits until it is ready, sends it the training workload and writes the classes it loaded to a file that is meant to be committed.
    RecordStartupProfileMojo
    Records the startup profile of the application: launches the runner jar that mn-runner:package wrote, waits until it is ready, sends it the training workload and writes the classes it loaded to "src/main/micronaut-runner/startup-classes.txt".
    RunnerClassLoader
    The class loader that serves an application straight out of its runner jar.
    RunnerJarBuilder
    Turns an application's own output and its resolved dependencies into a runner jar.
    RunnerJarOption
    Every packaging option of a runner jar, in one table: its name, the type of its value, its default, how the build plugins expose it and the Runner release that added it.
    RunnerJarOption.Exposure
    How the build plugins expose an option.
    RunnerJarReader
    Recognises a runner jar.
    RunnerJarResult
    What RunnerJarBuilder.build(RunnerJarSpec, BuildLogger) produced.
    RunnerJarSpec
    Everything RunnerJarBuilder needs to know to produce a runner jar.
    RunnerJarSpec.Builder
    Describes a runner jar step by step.
    StartupBenchmark
    The end-to-end startup benchmark: builds the sample application in every packaging the runner competes with, starts each of them many times, and reports how long each takes to answer its first request.
    StartupProfileRecorder
    Records the startup profile of an application: the classes a run of its runner jar loaded, in load order, written to a file that is meant to be committed and that the packager embeds for the launcher to preload.
    TrainingDriver
    Launches an application once for a training run and takes it down again, whatever happens in between.
    TrainingDriver.AfterWorkload
    What a training run does between its workload and its stop: read what the application recorded, or tell the JVM to finish a recording.
    TrainingDriver.Outcome
    How a training run ended.
    TrainingSettings
    How a training run exercises the application: how the run knows it is ready, what it asks of it, and how it stops it.
    TrainingSettings.Builder
    Collects training settings, starting from the defaults.
    TrainingSpec
    How a training run exercises the application: how the build knows it is ready, what it asks of it and how it stops it.
    ValidateShadowArchiveCollision
    Rejects a Shadow archive that shares a runner archive's output before either producer executes.
    ValidateShadowArchiveCollision.ArchivePair
    A Runner task and the Shadow task that writes the same archive name by default.
